subscription_auth.py.ChatGPTCredentials: Carry a validated access-token snapshot with a redacted representation; syntax validation does not verify its signature, expiry or remote subscription entitlement.
subscription_auth.py.ChatGPTCredentials.__post_init__: Validate bounded token/account/plan fields before they can become RPC parameters; never perform network authentication here.
subscription_auth.py.ChatGPTCredentials.__repr__: Return a fixed redacted identity without exposing account or access-token contents.
subscription_auth.py.ChatGPTCredentials.rpc_params: Export only the access-token snapshot, account ID and optional plan for private authentication RPC; no refresh token or provider fallback is included.
subscription_auth.py.ManagedTokenFile.__init__: Select an existing absolute credential path and optional host renewal hook without reading, creating or modifying credential storage.
subscription_auth.py.ManagedTokenFile.read: Read one bounded private owner-only regular file with stable descriptor/path identity and require ChatGPT mode; return only access credentials and sanitize source errors.
subscription_auth.py.ManagedTokenFile.tokens: Optionally invoke the configured host renewal hook for a refresh reason, then read off the event loop; rereading alone does not prove a token rotated.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth.__init__: Configure bounded account-bound authentication for one RPC connection, initially unattached and without credentials or a login attempt.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth.bind: Attach the guarded private refresh handler once to the selected RPC connection without starting login or a model turn.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth._reject: Retain a non-secret failure code and raise a subscription error without copying credential payloads into it.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth._check_active: Reject credential delivery after connection withdrawal or loss of the host activity predicate.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth._can_send: Check local connection attachment and current host authority; this predicate does not validate remote entitlement.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth.withdraw: Irreversibly stop further credential sends for this connection without cancelling or replaying a native turn.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth._load: Load a bounded typed snapshot only while active and preserve the original account; sanitize source failures that may contain credentials.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth.login: Attempt one guarded access-token login on the bound connection and require its expected local receipt; an unconfirmed login is not retried here.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth._refresh: Serialize bounded unauthorized refreshes for the same account and require a changed token before replying; never replay the client turn.
subscription_auth.py.ExternalChatGPTAuth.close: Withdraw this connection and clear retained account, token digest and RPC references without closing the shared host credential provider.

subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription.__init__: Configure one managed RPC owner with finite deadlines and a bounded resolution queue; construction does not read credentials or open the peer.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription.__aenter__: Open the managed owner once, initialize RPC and verify its ChatGPT account plus stable source account before making connections available.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription.__aexit__: Await the shared original provider shutdown when its ownership scope exits.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription.aclose: Withdraw new resolutions immediately and share one shielded shutdown task so cancelling a waiter cannot transfer shutdown ownership.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription._shutdown: Close the managed RPC before cancelling and draining owned resolution tasks, then clear the retained account identity.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription._digest: Fingerprint an access token for rotation comparison without retaining another plaintext copy or treating the hash as authentication.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription._check: Reject a withdrawn consumer or unavailable host owner before admitting managed credential work.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription._check_response: Require the managed account-read response shape and ChatGPT auth mode; do not infer remote entitlement from this local response.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription._snapshot: Read current host-managed credentials off the event loop and reject a change from the original account.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription._resolve: Admit one bounded host-owned resolution and shield it from consumer cancellation; host-cancelled work fails the waiting connection without replay.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription._work: Serialize account snapshots and necessary rotation; reuse an externally changed token and retire the provider after uncertain managed work instead of retrying it.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription.connection.tokens: Resolve this connection against its last delivered token digest and update that digest only after a successful host snapshot.
subscription_provider.py.HostSubscription._resolve.finished: Remove a settled resolution from capacity accounting and consume its failure even if the requesting connection has stopped waiting.

native_state.py._origin: Project the admitted database, attempt, fence, task/context and workspace binding into the immutable native-state origin.
native_state.py._directory: Require a private mode-0700 directory owned by the current user and return its device/inode identity without adopting another directory.
native_state.py._origin_key: Derive the deterministic journal lookup key for one original admission; the hash identifies data rather than granting execution authority.
native_state.py.NativeState.key: Return this retained state identity's journal key without creating or reopening state.
native_state.py.NativeState.load: Require the existing witnessed receipt, original authority/origin and unchanged private directories; never recreate missing state or authorize a turn.
native_state.py.NativeState.opened: Yield the pinned original home descriptor after verifying both directory identities and absence of auth.json, then close its descriptors on scope exit.
native_state.py.NativeState._record: Require the exact stored identity, journal authority and origin-to-state mapping in the supplied snapshot before returning the record.
native_state.py.NativeState.reservation: Return a proposed writer reservation for the original admission only after its previous operation is proved closed; the caller must commit the returned record.
native_state.py.NativeState._active: Require the same reserved operation under the active broker grant with its gate sent and execution still open; return its witnessed snapshot and record.
native_state.py.NativeState.bind_thread: Bind one validated thread receipt to the frozen original session intent, accepting the same receipt again without creating another thread.
native_state.py.NativeState.reserve_turn: Durably reserve the first input hash for the active original thread before dispatch; an existing reservation requires reconciliation rather than replay.

business_mediation.py._failure: Build the native tool-failure envelope as input text without dispatching, retrying or resolving a possible durable effect.
business_mediation.py.catalog_digest: Fingerprint the exact ordered catalog with deterministic JSON; matching metadata does not itself grant permission to call its tools.
business_mediation.py._BusinessPeer: Adapt one existing MCP SDK client while the enclosing business-peer scope records whether SDK teardown completed.
business_mediation.py.ProjectTools.__init__: Combine host-selected provider catalogs and require globally unique names before recording the dispatch map; construction does not call a tool.
business_mediation.py.ProjectTools.catalog_hash: Fingerprint the current combined catalog used for native thread admission.
business_mediation.py.ProjectTools.call: Route known names to their original provider and delegate invalid or unknown envelopes to the business boundary for rejection.
business_mediation.py.McpTools.__init__: Bind one existing peer, admitted catalog and live authority predicate without expanding capabilities or invoking the peer.
business_mediation.py.McpTools.catalog_hash: Fingerprint this admitted MCP projection for the native session intent.
business_mediation.py.McpTools.call: Validate current authority and the admitted envelope, dispatch once, and project bounded text results; late withdrawal or unsupported output requires receipt reconciliation.
business_mediation.py._BusinessPeer.__init__: Retain the existing SDK client and start with teardown unconfirmed; the enclosing scope alone marks it closed.
business_mediation.py._BusinessPeer.list_tools: Read capabilities through the already initialized client without opening another MCP connection.
business_mediation.py._BusinessPeer.call_tool: Forward one call to the existing SDK client without adding retries or changing its operation arguments.
